title: Mean values, order, and convergence in the Hardy space of Dirichlet series
summary: Let $\mathscr{H}^2$ denote the Hilbert space of Dirichlet series with square-summable coefficients. It follows from a theorem of Bohr that if $f$ in $\mathscr{H}^2$ has a bounded analytic continuation to the right half-plane, then its norm can be computed from the mean values \[\|f\|_{\mathscr{H}^2}^2 = \lim_{σ\to 0^+} \lim_{T\to\infty} \frac{1}{2T} \int_{-T}^T \lvert f(σ+it) \rvert^2\,dt.\] We investigate to what extent the assumption that the analytic continuation be bounded can be relaxed, and obtain optimal results in two different directions.
